device.description: Test source: scripted feature values that a hand-written identity test decoder turns into known cursor movements and clicks. Not neural data.

timing: recording.frame: device_timestamp_ns is the source-clock time of the frame's FIRST sample (LSL: its source timestamp; Open Ephys: sample number / rate, with first_sample_index exact); timestamp_ns is the Concord host wall clock at ingest. Sample i of a frame is at first + i / sample_rate_hz (nominal rate). Per-sample source timestamps inside a frame (e.g. LSL per-sample stamps and their jitter) are not stored and cannot be reconstructed.
